html:
Goal

Pull the guitar chords and lyrics out of a YouTube video (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UFA2vNK1qXY), keeping each chord in the same place over the lyrics as in the video.


Tool

Cursor (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)

Steps

  1. I asked Cursor to transcribe directly from the video. Its answer, more or less: “I’m sorry, Dave. I’m afraid I can’t do that.”

2. Next I took a screenshot of the first section of chords and lyrics, pasted it in, and asked Cursor to turn it into text with the chords lined up over the right words. Success.

3. More screenshots, pasted in. It turns out you can add several screenshots at once, and Cursor outputs the text in order.


Summary

With multiple screenshots, Cursor can extract the chords and lyrics as text, mostly keeping the alignment from the video. On top of that, it told me the chord progression, though that probably has to do with my having asked it similar questions before. It also told me the chords were power chords and that the song is punk rock.

Shortcomings:

  • It can’t pull the text directly from a video
  • In a few places the chords and lyrics don’t line up quite right
  • About Cursor itself: with Claude there’s no way to export the chat history, so screenshots are all you get


For jobs like this: how could I get Cursor, or other AI agents, to work smarter? How could I write better prompts? Or what did I miss? Suggestions welcome!
